etw_record_graph_mapping.warning: No per-pass CPU unit timing or declared topology payload captured. Do not infer CPU costs from GPU timing; do not assume a target is one job or one physical worker; no ideal repartition speedup predicted.

limitations: No post-change benchmark; no Windows host build/native GPU execution in the implementation environment.
OS Running includes scheduler/instrumentation work; Waiting does not identify a specific mutex or fence.
Record target indices are command targets, not stable physical Worker thread indices.
Record target/job wall sums overlap; do not add them to obtain critical path. No per-unit callback timing or actual recorded topology payload is available.
GPU figures sum measured pass durations in a homogeneous per-view cohort. They are not calibrated queue busy-union or GPU frame-span p95.
Baseline and ETW are separate capture windows with distinct instrumentation/background conditions. Rate differences are observations, not isolated causal estimates of profiler overhead.

implementation_static_review.scope: Independent static review of the working implementation; not a native driver or performance test.

contracts.finding: Span/scalar-only contiguous minimax candidate; rejects sum overflow before writing; existing consider() retains CPU dependency, wave and critical-work admission.
Both raster split callers use RasterRecordingSlices<=4; Graph clamps to min(pass.maxSlices,poolWorkers). Increasing command targets to8 does not enlarge the slice index beyond0..3.
Common max targets=8; backend slots/encoders follow initialized worker count; DX12 submission array has8 slots and translation forks inherit worker count.
Normal Editor/Player bootstrap synchronously starts scheduler before app construction/Initialize and before renderer live pipeline initialization; no startup fallback1 sticking path found.

Target-count guard precedes fixed results access. Stable read-only cost order with atomic unique claims preserves target/segment exclusive ownership; joined results/error selection/final submission retain original target order.

include_boundary_validation.note: The checker still fails. The full-tree HEAD extra failure is an absent ThirdParty project in the sparse checkout, not a change made by this PR. No allowlist or scanner edits.

methodology.use: Official README measurement/concurrency/allocator methodology; no external code copied. Distinguish measurements from static evidence, cumulative work from dependency critical path; reuse fixed/owned storage; no speedup claim before renderer remeasurement.
